biotools.summary: TimeFlow 2 is a Python method that infers cell lineage differentiation pathways from a static flow cytometry snapshot by ordering cells along pseudotime, building cell-state paths, and grouping them with an optimal transport-based cost function; it was validated on healthy bone marrow samples, recovering monocyte, neutrophil, erythrocyte and B-cell lineages.
biotools.name: TimeFlow 2
